pattern: SVG calendar grid as a named, described group (role="group" with aria-roledescription "calendar heatmap") of role="img" days with roving focus following the APG date grid keys (day and week); a legend of steps and day types; data table fallback.

roles.role: group with aria-roledescription "calendar heatmap" (localized), named by the title
img with an aria-label: date, value (or "No value"), and holiday name or "Non-working day"

roles.element: month and weekday labels, holiday dots, tooltip
roles.role: aria-hidden (decorative duplicates of the accessible data)

aria.value: id of the visible (or visually hidden) title
description id (when provided) and the generated summary id
0 on exactly one mark (roving); other marks have none
Table open state and the table region id
Localized: date, value (or "No value"), and holiday name or "Non-working day"

keyboard.action: Same weekday of the previous / next week (swapped in RTL).
First / last day of the week.
Same day of the previous / next month (Shift: year), clamped to the range.
Hides the tooltip without moving focus (WCAG 1.4.13); it returns on the next move.
One tab stop for the plot (the active mark), then the Show data table button and the table region.

focus: Roving focus: one day is in the tab sequence and keeps the last visited day across re-renders. Moves stop at the first and last day of the range.
notes: Lightness is never the only cue: every day's accessible name and tooltip carry its exact value, the legend lists every step's range, and the data table lists every day.
Non-working days and holidays are marked by an outline style and a dot, and named in text, not by color.
The week starts on the locale's first day (getFirstDayOfWeek) unless firstDayOfWeek is set.
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver, TalkBack) is pending.
A year is many key presses; browse-mode users can read the data table instead.
